title: Evolutionary Deep Nets for Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring
abstract: arXiv:2303.03538v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Compact appliance classifiers can support local electricity-load monitoring where memory and computation are constrained. We evaluate adaptive sparse evolutionary training and warm-start compression using synthetic aggregate windows derived from household appliance recordings. A completed convolutional network study trains 120 models over four targets and three seeds with validation-only model selection. Two analyses examine compression with approximately preserved binary accuracy and joint improvement in positive-class F1 and sparsity. Relative to a newly trained fixed sparse evolutionary baseline, the selected compressed policy changes accuracy from 91.53%, while increasing macro F1 to 92.40%. Stored weights decrease by 17.36% and active first-layer connections by 23.93%. Refinement requires additional training. translated_title: 用于非侵入式负荷监测的进化深度网络
translated_abstract: 紧凑的电器分类器可以支持内存和计算受限的本地电力负荷监测。我们使用从家用电器记录中导出的合成聚合窗口，评估了自适应稀疏进化训练和热启动压缩方法。一项完整的卷积网络研究在四个目标和三个随机种子上训练了120个模型，且仅通过验证集进行模型选择。两项分析分别考察了在近似保持二分类准确率的情况下进行压缩，以及正类F1与稀疏性的联合提升。与新训练的固定稀疏进化基线相比，所选的压缩策略将准确率从91.53%进行了调整，同时将宏F1提升至92.40%。存储权重减少了17.36%，第一层活跃连接减少了23.93%。进一步的精炼需要额外的训练。由于仅使用了三个随机种子且源窗口独立性未经证实，无法对统计等价性或在未见房屋上的性能作出声明。
tldr: 本研究提出并评估了用于非侵入式负荷监测的自适应稀疏进化训练与热启动压缩方法，在保持准确率的同时将宏F1提升至92.40%，并使存储权重减少17.36%、第一层活跃连接减少23.93%。
en_tdlr: This study evaluates adaptive sparse evolutionary training and warm-start compression for non-intrusive load monitoring, improving macro F1 to 92.40% while reducing stored weights by 17.36% and active first-layer connections by 23.93%.
